svg.title: Five checks before scaling a Meta campaign
svg.desc: Name the result, keep the account, count about fifty results a week, change one thing, and separate a sale from an Ads Manager result.

g.text: 1. Name the result: message, call, visit, or a sale you counted yourself.
2. The ad account, pixel and page stay in the clients name.
3. About 50 results in a week is Metas usual exit from learning.
4. Change budget or creative, not both on the same day.
5. Do not call a message a sale.
